# Fire Mage — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Build (levels 10-60), 10/38/3 — no respec, one build from level 10 to 60. The decision loop walks 112 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 38 (2 members), level 48 (1 member), level 51 (1 member), level 60 (6 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/mage/fire/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **OK** — 52% of the human spec median (294 vs 571.2 (n=6, one dungeon) boss DPS over 75 boss fights); reference is one boss's 6 parses; mix is right [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [fire.md](./fire.md).

## Abilities and when they are learned

The learn level is the first level the bot can have the ability: a trainer, starting, quest or item level from `kit.yaml`, or the talent point in the build above.

| Learn level | Ability | Ranks in the kit | Learned via | Used from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Arcane Intellect | Rank 1 at 1, Rank 2 at 1, Rank 3 at 28, Rank 4 at 42, Rank 5 at 56 | trainer | 1 |
| 1 | Fireball | Rank 1 at 1, Rank 2 at 6, Rank 3 at 12, Rank 4 at 18, Rank 5 at 24, Rank 6 at 30, Rank 7 at 36, Rank 8 at 42, Rank 9 at 48, Rank 10 at 54, Rank 11 at 60, Rank 12 at 60 | starting-kit | 1 |
| 1 | Frost Armor | Rank 1 at 1, Rank 2 at 10, Rank 3 at 20 | starting-kit | 1 |
| 1 | Shoot | Rank 1 at 1 | starting-kit | 1 |
| 4 | Conjure Water | Rank 1 at 4, Rank 2 at 10, Rank 3 at 20, Rank 4 at 30, Rank 5 at 40, Rank 6 at 50, Rank 7 at 60 | trainer | 4 |

The two foods grant different Well Fed auras (57044 spell damage, 57046 haste; DB tkbplay-346), so a Delight eaten earlier is not replaced by a Medley eaten on top; the cost is that a Delight eaten on trash is kept through the boss pull.

- **MI07f-frost-nova-runner — Frost Nova:** HO-TKB-PLAY-143 (p4-group, round 130: the top party wipe cause, 12 wipe-fights in the Deadmines, was foundry goblins fleeing at 15 per cent to fetch help within 30 yd; p3-runtime 357 makes the melee follow a fleer at or under 25 per cent; bears, paladins, rogues and shamans already stop runners on target.fleeing): Frost Nova roots a runner still within its 10 yd, so it cannot reach help; the melee then finish it.
- **MI03-arcane-intellect — Arcane Intellect:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **MI04p-polymorph-moon — Polymorph:** Polymorph-able is spell 118's own TargetCreatureType: beast (1), humanoid (7) or critter (8), so a Molten Elemental (4) is never marked and never sheeped here. Two branches, so it never re-casts on a sheep with time left: a mob with no sheep aura (any of the four ranks 118, 12824, 12825, 12826) is sheeped while two or more enemies are engaged on the party (the marked mob itself counts once it is awake and attacking, a sheeped one attacks nobody, so the second case needs one other enemy: the last mob standing is never sheeped); a mob that carries the sheep is sheeped again only under 3 s left (target.aura_ms, v17) and while at least one other enemy is engaged.
- **MI04s-polymorph-second — Polymorph:** `target: other_engaged` (v10), a hostile that attacks the resident and is not the target; beast, humanoid or critter only (spell 118's TargetCreatureType, as the party rule); two enemies engaged, none sheeped within 40 yd (one Polymorph per caster; Frost Nova, Arcane Explosion and the rest already carry `not sheeped_within`, so they do not break it); standing; 60 mana (rank 1) and 30 per cent of the bar.
- **MI05-mana-shield — Mana Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).

- **MI08-counterspell-t3 — Counterspell:** HO-TKB-PLAY-192 and 193 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, p1-loop v41 casting list): the ranked version of MI08-counterspell, tier 3 of 3 (rank 2, summons and interruptible channels; 14 ids). - **MI08-counterspell — Counterspell:** The interrupt: 100 mana, instant, 30 yd, 30 s categoryRecoveryTime. No substitute exists: 2139 has no lower rank and no other mage spell interrupts at the pin (OQ-2743).
- **MI10m-remove-lesser-curse-must — Remove Lesser Curse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **MI10-remove-lesser-curse — Remove Lesser Curse:** Free at the pin; DispelType 2 is curse. The mage's only curse removal (see the frost file's note on the 2782 class mask).
- **MI00s-caster-first-10499 — Fireball:** Its spell list (tkbplay-201.result.txt: 104990, Wail of Souls 17631, 7,580-8,059 hp, level 58-60) is instant and not interruptible per p4-group (spell_template: castingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0; not re-read here), so no interrupt rule can answer it and killing it is the only kit answer; same shape and gates as the 10471 rule, just ahead of it.
- **MI00s-peel-11197 — Fireball:** Other Stratholme Undead adds are not sourced.
- **MI00s-caster-first-10471 — Fireball:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **MI00s-caster-first-10470 — Fireball:** Mana Burn 17615 is instant and not interruptible (CastingTimeIndex 1, interruptFlags 0), so killing the caster is the only kit answer. amp-4's own count: the Acolyte/Neophyte pair is the killer in 149 of 263 deaths, but only 3 of 42 windows were kill-order-limited, so this is the orchestrator's ask, not the largest lever.
- **MI13-flamestrike — Flamestrike:** This rule is the rank 6 (the highest rank the engine casts) and now waits while its own DoT (aura 10216, the rank spell id, DB tkbplay-360) is on the target; MI13g-flamestrike-rank-5 is the second cast.
- **MI13g-flamestrike-rank-5 — Flamestrike:** HO-TKB-PLAY-360 (fire.md L116, L120): the second Flamestrike of the pair, rank 5 (DB 10215, level 48, 580 mana) cast on the pack while the rank 6 DoT (aura 10216) runs and the rank 5 DoT (aura 10215) is not on: two different ranks let both DoTs tick at once.
- **MI13b-pyroblast-opener — Pyroblast:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MI17w-shoot-trash — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-065 (owner approved, via the orchestrator: the mage spends to empty on every trash fight, 28 of 56 fights under 20 per cent in round 86, and drinks after almost every pull; wand earlier on trash, keep full nukes for bosses and big pulls): the wand instead of a nuke when the target is under 30 per cent health, or the mage is under 40 per cent mana, in a fight that is not a boss or a big pull. Boss and big-pull test, from what a rule can read in combat: `not (target.ttd_ms >= 15000)` (a target the party will take 15 s or more to kill is a long fight; null reads true, so a fresh target is trash until it proves otherwise) and `enemies_engaged_within(30) <= 3` (a pack of four or more keeps the nukes and the area spells).
- **MI14-fire-blast — Fire Blast:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group - round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe - the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372) - while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MI16-scorch — Scorch:** Two gates: the level is 41 (the talent), and from 41 only on a boss or a target that will live 30 s (five Scorches are 7.5 s of casting for a debuff that pays over the rest of the fight: "for fire vulnerability if target is alive for 1 min", the archive consensus; ttd_ms is printed only while the target is losing health, so a fresh target gets Fireball first). HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MI15a-scorch-finisher — Scorch:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand. MAG-08 took Scorch out as the filler before Fire Vulnerability (29), and in round sixteen Emberlys Fireball interrupts rose to 47, 44 of them reason target_lost (the target died during the cast; Hooks.cpp), none while moving.
- **MI15s-frostbolt-slow — Frostbolt:** Frostbolt R1 116 and R2 205 carry the chill as aura 33 under their own spell id (DB); the rule fires only while no chill or Nova root is on the mob and it is still more than 10 yd away, so it is the opener and not a second damage spell.
- **MI15-fireball — Fireball:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031, p4-group: round 132 Wailing Caverns ritual wipe: the mage spent 1545 mana in 40 s on three elite Moccasins and met the seven Nightmare Ectoplasms at 13 then 1 mana, with no Arcane Explosion or Frost Nova; v32 party.ritual, p4-group 372): while the party escorts a ritual, single-target spells keep 40 per cent mana for the area wave unless the target is a boss; below it the wand.
- **MI17-shoot — Shoot:** HO-TKB-PLAY-149 (PIONEER FIX PIO-031): also while a ritual is on below 40 per cent mana (not on a boss), where the spenders hold back for the area wave. Measured on d-20260917T070130Z-p3, actor 358: the wand was 26 per cent of the mage''s casts, 86 per cent of its starts were unasked, 7 ticks were wand-locked, and 35 of its own casts came back SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED -- the bot''s own movement cancelling its own auto-repeat.
